SELECT MIN(kt.kind) AS movie_kind, MIN(t.title) AS complete_us_internet_movie
FROM complete_cast AS cc
INNER JOIN comp_cast_type AS cct1 ON cc.status_id = cct1.id
INNER JOIN movie_companies AS mc ON cc.movie_id = mc.movie_id
INNER JOIN company_name AS cn ON mc.company_id = cn.id
INNER JOIN company_type AS ct ON mc.company_type_id = ct.id
INNER JOIN movie_info AS mi ON cc.movie_id = mi.movie_id
INNER JOIN info_type AS it1 ON mi.info_type_id = it1.id
INNER JOIN movie_keyword AS mk ON cc.movie_id = mk.movie_id
INNER JOIN keyword AS k ON mk.keyword_id = k.id
INNER JOIN title AS t ON cc.movie_id = t.id
INNER JOIN kind_type AS kt ON t.kind_id = kt.id
WHERE cct1.kind = 'complete+verified'
AND cn.country_code = '[us]'
AND it1.info = 'release dates'
AND kt.kind IN ('movie', 'tv movie', 'video movie', 'video game')
AND mi.note LIKE '%internet%'
AND mi.info IS NOT NOT NULL
AND (mi.info LIKE 'USA:% 199%' OR mi.info LIKE 'USA:% 200%')
AND t.production_year > 1990
